note: Undo / redo (package 25 A): character commands listed here are not put on the undo stack. Session operations (new, open, close, save, restore_backup, file operations), app settings and catalog edits never go through Session.dispatch, so they are never on the stack; opening or creating a character clears both stacks.
keep_note: Package 27 D (review 5 F3 F17): undo / redo bring back an older state but keep these fields of the CURRENT state: the data of the non-undoable commands (char_settings) and the journal (an undo line is appended to the current journal, never to the restored one).
